claim: The official JSON Schema output-format spec requires each output unit to carry an evaluation path, schema location and instance location, and requires the results property to be an array so multiple output units can hold every validation result, not only the first.
query: JSON Schema validation output format specification multiple errors list hierarchical
read:
Each output unit MUST contain the validation result for
the associated subschema as well as the following information defined by
JSON Schema "Output Formatting":

Evaluation Path

Schema Location

Instance Location

The following information MAY be included conditionally:

When subschema validation has succeeded

Annotations

When subschema validation has failed

Errors

Dropped Annotations

Implementations MAY elect to provide additional information.
snippet:
In order to accommodate
potentially multiple results, the value of this property MUST be an array of
output units, even if only a single output unit is produced.
title: A Specification for Machine-Readable Output for JSON Schema Validation and Annotation
topic: JSON Schema 2020-12's own output-format specification requires the ability to report multiple validation results, not only the first, replacing a fabricated 'single pass'/RFC 6901 quote misattributed to an unrelated blog post

claim: A2A's own specification defines Extension as a formal mechanism letting agents add functionality or data beyond the core protocol, distinct from Context (an optional grouping identifier for tasks and messages).
query: A2A protocol specification extension mechanism agent capability
read:
Context: An optional identifier to logically group related tasks and messages.

Extension: A mechanism for agents to provide additional functionality or data beyond the core A2A specification.
snippet: Extension: A mechanism for agents to provide additional functionality or data beyond the core A2A specification.
title: Overview - A2A Protocol
topic: A2A's own specification defines a formal extension mechanism for capability beyond the core spec, replacing a fabricated 'Version 1.0.1 (May 2026)' quote whose page never mentions it

claim: This source frames the shared Linux Foundation governance of MCP, A2A and ACP as an institutional signal that the protocols will stay layered and complementary rather than merging into one technical format.
query: MCP A2A ACP Linux Foundation governance convergence Agentic AI Foundation
read: The clearest directional signal is the convergence of Linux Foundation governance. With MCP (under AAIF), A2A, and ACP all now under Linux Foundation governance, and with the same platinum sponsors (AWS, Google, Microsoft, IBM, Anthropic, Salesforce) backing multiple protocols, the industry is signaling a future where these protocols are formally layered and complementary rather than independently competing.
snippet: With MCP (under AAIF), A2A, and ACP all now under Linux Foundation governance, and with the same platinum sponsors (AWS, Google, Microsoft, IBM, Anthropic, Salesforce) backing multiple protocols, the industry is signaling a future where these protocols are formally layered and complementary rather than independently competing.
title: ACP vs MCP vs A2A: The Complete Guide to AI Agent Protocols
topic: MCP, A2A and ACP now share Linux Foundation governance and platinum sponsors, described by this source as institutional convergence rather than a single technical wire format, replacing a fabricated 'technical debt' quote and an invented AAIF founding-date/co-founder list misattributed to a different page
